messages.subject: Series A — engaging Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you for the call last week. We'd like to formally instruct Whitfield Carter on our Series A. Ravensworth Ventures are leading with Aldridge Seed alongside; we expect a term sheet from them shortly. Headline numbers we've been discussing are £10m of new money at a £30m pre.

Could you send your engagement terms and let me know the team? Keen to move quickly — our runway gets tight over the summer.

Best,
Alice

Dr Alice Wren
CEO, Larkmoor Bioscience Limited

messages.subject: RE: Series A — engaging Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alice,

Delighted to act. I'm attaching our engagement letter and terms of business — please sign and return at your convenience, and we'll need the usual AML/ID for the company and directors.

The team will be me, James Osei (Senior Associate) leading day to day, and Elena Marchetti supporting. We'll review the term sheet as soon as it lands and revert with a short note on the key points.

Welcome aboard.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
